name: @internal/api
description: Evasion for check 10 (vulnerable-dependency): scanNpmAudit() only ever looks at path.join(repoPath, 'package.json') -- the package.json sitting directly at the SCANNED ROOT. It never walks subdirectories looking for nested/workspace package.json files. A monorepo/workspace layout where the vulnerable dependency is pinned inside a nested package (packages/api/package.json) rather than at the repo root is therefore completely invisible to check 10, even though `npm audit` run *from inside packages/api* would report it immediately. This directory deliberately has no package.json at its own root (test/fixtures/evasion-attempts/10-vulnerable-dependency/) to reproduce that exact blind spot.
